description: Agent Construction: submit a contractor bid with the project scope or request it answers: the bid with the bidder, bid number, date, currency, each line with its id, the request item it answers, the scope item as described, quantity, unit, unit amount and line amount, and its total; the request with its number, who issued it, the day bids are due, currency and each scope item with its id, description, quantity and unit. The signed report gives the bid and the request, each bid line matched to its request item, the requested items left out, the lines unrequested, bid below or above the requested quantity or in another unit, the lines whose amount is not their quantity times their unit amount, and the total against its lines, and counts them, and names a divergent bid: a requested scope item the bid leaves out, a quantity below the request, a line amount unlike its quantity times its unit amount, and a total unlike its lines; then a line the request does not list, a quantity above the request, another unit and a bid dated after the due day, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No requested items, no bid total, or a requested quantity the bid line leaves unstated leaves the bid unverified. Lines meet request items by the request item they name, then by the item described; units read with their common short forms, so sf and square feet read as one, and amounts compare to the cent. This reads one contractor bid against the request it answers: wever_quote-compare compares two to twenty provider quotes for the same job by their totals and terms, and wever_vendor-quote-check reads one vendor quote for implied fees, scope and expiry, while the bid check reads each scope item, quantity and the total against the request’s own scope list. Verdict build_bid_divergent, build_bid_partial, build_bid_unverified or build_bid_consistent. POST /api/build-bid-check. Reads the construction paperwork supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads consistency between documents only, with no structural, engineering or safety judgment, building-code compliance determination, valuation of work performed or legal advice on contracts, liens or permits, and the paperwork stays in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Construction reads supplied construction paperwork for consistency between documents: a building permit, a contractor license record, a bid, a construction contract, a change order, a lien waiver, a completion certificate or punch list record, and a payment application. Beside it, wever_workorder-create and the other wever_workorder tools and wever_agent-work-order-exchange are the action layer that creates, funds, delivers and releases work orders, while this family moves nothing and executes nothing and only reads paperwork; wever_agent-escrow-lite holds and releases escrowed funds, and escrow stays there; and the Agent Real Estate checks such as wever_realty-title-check read property records by parcel and address, not a project’s construction paperwork. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-construction-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-construction/.
